title: THE BASE FROM SCRATCH: the dome city at 0.65 no longer founded, its six domes bought on the build board and printed by Isao between waves, the four bridges following their domes by themselves (when.stand), the wheeled Stålheart a look behind ?gantry=kidou, and the --dome-print suite
context: The owner's note of 2026-11-07: 'The base should not be built yet. Isao comes out and starts a base from scratch ... they need biomass to do so', with the domes smaller and the wheeled Stålheart (the KIDOU, imported the same day) to be looked at in the base. Round 8 had made the dome city the default layout with every dome and bridge `founded` (standing from a grown base's first frame, no print step), at full size: 80 m apart in z, the bridges' deck 7.5 m up. Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-base-from-scratch-design.md (sections 2 and 3), plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-07-base-from-scratch.md, five tasks on branch base-from-scratch (worktree ~/Dev/stalheart-base) from 06af741c, each reviewed; the owner asleep.
outcome: LANDED, unpushed (commits 6a36910a..this one). THE SIZE: DOME_SCALE 0.65 in src/content/dome-city.js; the islands 20 x 20 at x +-80, z 0 and +-70.2; the bridges keep their 52 m deck and 4.4 x 54 plot and take 0.65 in height only (`scaleY`, src/fx/story-base.js place()), at z +-35.1 = 26 m to the bridge's end + the port 14 x 0.65; lift -0.37 (the sag between the end and the port, -0.39 on the formula, -0.37 kept on the sphere's measurement: the end columns +0.025 m over the slabs, the sockets 0.042 m under the ports). THE CLEARANCE: the deck's underside 7.5 x 0.65 = 4.875 m, 4.505 m once lowered, 1.49 m over the MÖRK's 3.016 m (the test asks >= 1.0). THE NUDGES: HUGIN (-52, -40) -> (-52, -36) (its slab 0.2 m from dome-nw's plot; 4 m wanted), the boards (-38, 2) -> (-36, 6). THE PROGRAMME: `when.stand: [ids]` in src/domain/build-programme.js (due once every named structure stands; no `standing` answer means nothing stands), the story's stands(id) (mounted, shown, no print under way) handed to the programme host and the board; six dome steps after the fourth Bio-Pearl, `board: true`, island then module, 18 s, idle, sector 1 for nw/ne, 2 for w/e, 3 for sw/se; prices habitat 2400 kg, biosphere 3000, fabrication 2800, logistics 2400, the effect naming the dome, structuresMax 4; four bridge steps last, passable, not for sale, `when.stand` on their two domes, a frame-anchored plot in src/fx/base-print.js; Isao's build_dome and build_bridge; a dome's card thumbnail from its LOD2. Static pages at stage >= 2 and SKIP TUTORIAL still stand the whole city; ?base=classic untouched. THE KIDOU: ?gantry=kidou (gantryMode, stalheartEntry, src/fx/kidou-rig.js) parks the moving gantry centred on the Stålheart's slab (offset 0: at the rail model's +10 m its plot would hang 5.5 m off the slab), the party's crane pose a no-op without Terraforming_Cycle; the default stays the rail terraformer. --DOME-PRINT (new, scripts/browser-test.mjs): ?skip=sector-1 (the tutorial's last chapter: a growing base, the spine to the solar array printed, no dome or bridge shown), sector 1 held by the ledger's defender, CONTINUE opens the board (bank 13,077-13,242 kg over three runs; offers scoreboard 1500, garage 2500, armory 3200, habitat dome NW 2400, an upgrade, shield charges), dome-nw picked by its key and paid at ENTER (-2400 kg), its card thumbnail drawn (96 px); sector 2 quiet, dome-w bought through the harness's new programmeBuy (the programme's own buy, unpaid; one hook on an existing line of src/td-tab.js, 0 lines added: no board deals dome-w before the scoreboard, the garage, the armory, the farm and the pearl are bought); Isao prints radar and assembly, then dome-nw (start to standing ~23 s), dome-w (~19 s later), then bridge-w1 by itself ~9 s after dome-w stands, unbought; dome-ne, the far pair and the other three bridges stay unshown; both of Isao's lines said. Stills: dome-print-mid.png (dome-nw's wire half risen on its slab at k 0.5, Isao beside it), dome-print-end.png (the two west domes and bridge-w1 between them). bestiary.js's BRIDGES fact now says the deck is about 4.5 m up. NOT DONE: the KIDOU driving and printing the domes (spec 2.D, designed only), the DAY 42 ball under a parked KIDOU (~3 m into the slab), the story lab's ?gantry, a dome's mechanical effect.
alternatives: --dome-print on a bare growing page (?world=story&grow=1, the spec's wording): rejected for the step, the opening to the handover alone is ~140 s headless before sector 1's hold and the board; ?skip=sector-1 is the same growing base at the tutorial's end (programme.grow true, no dome standing), not SKIP TUTORIAL's static stage 8

Buy dome-w through the board too: not possible on this path, the board deals the first four structure cards in the programme's order (scoreboard, garage, armory, dome-nw before sector 2; the farm and the pearl ahead of dome-w after); buying those first would take two more boards and sectors
Buy both domes through the hook: rejected, the board's real CONTINUE, keys and ENTER are the player's path and dome-nw's card (its thumbnail, its price) is seen nowhere else
Keep the domes founded and only resize them: rejected by the owner's note, the base starts from scratch and costs biomass
Scale the bridges uniformly to 0.65: rejected, the deck would shrink to ~34 m and no longer reach the ports at +-26 m; the pair spacing is set by the full-length bridge
